changesets.summary:
Fix duplicate parameter names in generated ColorPicker focus/blur,
ConversationListItem select, and TreeV2 node-contextmenu declarations. Preserve
event names, payload types and order, validators, and runtime behavior.

Preserve the inbox, metric, and settings component alias contracts through named
public declaration types, avoiding expanded Vue instance generics in installed
packages. Runtime component names, installation, props, emits, slots, and
instances remain unchanged.

Resolve internal WASM declaration references within the installed package while
keeping generated WASM subpaths outside the public exports contract.

Rename MarkdownEditor transaction and selection payload parameter labels so the
official declaration producer does not repeat Vue's event-name parameter.
Preserve event names, payload types and order, runtime validation and behavior.
Resolve public motion declarations through the implementation index so `useScrollReveal` and its types remain usable from the compiled package.

Keep GSAP types in the emitted motion declarations so installed consumers can
resolve scroll and timeline options and inferred controls without ambient setup.
Use the actual Popper core instance return type for ordinary Table overflow tooltips so generated declarations compile without expanding a Vue component instance. Preserve tooltip runtime behavior.

Include the existing pinned Vue Router and type-fest dependencies needed by the
published component and utility declarations.
